4413.title: Request and suggestion responsiveness
4413.rootCauseOneLine: Synchronous FTS blocks the request event loop; settled listings are discarded; aggregate mention publication awaits all providers.

prReviews.verdict: Reference only — closed prototype not executed
prReviews.topFinding: 26 files and multiple subsystems; outside the automatic simple-fix scope.

4413.proposedFix: Separate owner-level repairs with explicit discovery freshness, compatible independent provider delivery, and consistent off-loop search execution.
4413.caveats: Rendered stale suggestions, historical magnitudes, and packaged startup were not directly verified. Backend mechanisms repeated by the same agent in two clean checkouts.
